1:1.label: Clock face
1:1.notes: Music Lounge + Clock's corner role (docs/concept-scenes.md §2.5.1): the timer page's numeral stage, cut square. The clock FACE - the time of day in those numerals rather than a countdown - is still the page's to grow (CS-3 owns targets/win-host/PrismHost/Assets/tiles/timer); until it does, this preset resolves to the same stage and shows the countdown. The preset is catalog data and correct as it stands: only the page has to change.

notes: Prism's own timer, served locally at https://tiles.prism/timer/ from the host's Assets/tiles. Countdown and interval modes, minute presets, and the §24 chime at zero - a bundled local tone (scripts/make-chime.mjs writes it, so its licence is ours), played at the level set on the page and never louder. Chime off is silent. It runs on device time: the deadline is stored (§10), so a reload or a restart picks the run back up and says so. No account, no sign-in, no network.
